mentions.name: Micro Arcade
mentions.description: A micro-arcade collection of one-button games playable on mobile or in the browser, built using a small game library the author found. Each game is a quick creative experiment implemented in an hour or two, and they are described as rough around the edges but playable.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have been making a micro-arcade of one button games using a fun little library I found.
